top_categories.workout_context: When someone attacks on flat, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Race-pace efforts that mimic UCI Granfondo Bogotá's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before December.
53ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
UCI Granfondo Bogotá's flat forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 79 miles.
79 miles on flat burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of UCI Granfondo Bogotá. Train it until it feels boring.
At UCI Granfondo Bogotá, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Base fitness for UCI Granfondo Bogotá. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At UCI Granfondo Bogotá, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on flat. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,186ft of climbing on flat does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for UCI Granfondo Bogotá’s 79 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: UCI Granfondo Bogotá with 4,186ft of climbing, much of it above 8,000ft demands altitude preparation. Arrive 5–7 days early for acclimatization. Expect 5–15% power reduction at altitude. Increase iron intake 4 weeks out. Hydrate aggressively — altitude increases fluid loss by 20–40%.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at UCI Granfondo Bogotá requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on flat to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 79 miles of flat in Bogotá, Colombia.
